about: Look-loop capture set. Each active view is one WorldLab launch in the Simulator with the args below (plus the common args). Targets are concept images in docs/proposals (read-only). Times are UTC; 'local' is the area's local time. 'na' lists v2 §8.3 criteria that cannot be scored from this still (6 = no character in frame, 10 = motion needs video). 'wet' turns on the rain-readability art-direction criterion. Placeholders stay inactive until the named hook lands.

frame.note: letterboxed inside the iPhone 17 Pro portrait screen (1206 px wide), the v2/experience-v1 comparison frame
